scenarios.expected: The Requester sees the supported progress and conversation for their own Request after disposition. A second Business User cannot open it; Legal-only conversation and internal work details remain unavailable.
scenarios.actual: Jonas opened R-46 (Open), R-47 (In progress, Contract), R-48 (In progress, Matter), R-49 (Resolved), and R-50 (Declined, reason shown) from Your requests; each page carried the summary, R- reference line, requester status pill, and banner text, and no C-37 or M-24 reference. Conversation showed Nadia's Full thread replies and paper before and after the disposition, with the resolution reply on R-49, and never the Legal only or Working team notes, radios, or an Audience control; the paper downloaded byte-for-byte. What you submitted showed the description, the original attachment with its original bytes, Urgency High, and the answer. Send stayed unavailable without a message, also with a file selected; each reply with paper appeared once under You and reloaded with the pill unchanged, and Nadia read it on the Inbox or record page. Attach new files to a reply reached #portal-request-composer on the four decided Requests and was absent on the Open one. Amara's browser returned to /portal and her API reads answered 404 for the Request and its file; Jonas's staff reads answered 403 and /contracts/37 and /matters/24 returned him to /portal. Later Document Versions on C-37 and M-24 left the original attachment bytes unchanged. Show earlier replies grew 50 rows to 61 with focus on the oldest loaded reply; a failed reply kept the text and file and the retry posted once; a failed read kept What you submitted and reload recovered; a failed earlier page kept the rows and the retry loaded.
